title: Stale or closed WHIP WebRtcTransport DTLS handler corrupts room state and triggers premature session teardown
test: none added (claim does not hold); scratch probe .arbitra/dev-notes/results/check-08-probe.cjs.txt (real mediasoup 3.27.1 worker, router and UDP WebRtcTransports on 127.0.0.1, the real WHIP router on a real HTTP server; DTLS state changes delivered through mediasoup's own Channel.processNotification, as the worker delivers them), run on dev c7489d0 (lane lifecycle) and with ac1c688's lib/whipRoutes.js, whip.js, rooms.js, roomMediaPipeline.js, sessionRegistry.js and roomLifecycle.js written over the lane and restored afterwards; outputs check-08-probe-output-dev-c7489d0.json and check-08-probe-output-ac1c688.json
proof: Does not hold, now or on ac1c688 (the dtlsstatechange listener is unchanged: lib/whipRoutes.js:421-535 now, :410-524 at ac1c688). What is true: the 'failed'/'closed' branch (:516 now, :505 then) has no generation or transport check, unlike the 'connected' branch (:424). What is false: that a transport the server closes runs it. mediasoup 3.27.1 Transport.close() removes the transport's channel subscription synchronously before asking the worker to close it (node_modules/mediasoup/node/lib/Transport.js:147; routerClosed :188 and listenServerClosed :224 do the same), and WebRtcTransport.close() sets dtlsState to 'closed' without emitting (WebRtcTransport.js:117-128). dtlsstatechange is emitted only from the worker-notification handler (WebRtcTransport.js:220-230), which Channel dispatches by handler id in a setImmediate (Channel.js:304-311), so a notification still queued at close time finds no listener. Every path that drops room.whipTransport closes it: closeWhipSession (:117-122, run by the replacing POST :335 and by DELETE :616), cancelPendingStart (:269-271), the superseded check (:396-399), the POST catch (:573-576), the no-fingerprint 400 (:412) and the roomLifecycle fallback (lib/roomLifecycle.js:25-31). So no open transport other than the room's current one ever has this listener, and for the current one the grace path is the intended behaviour. Probe, identical on both revisions: (A) a closed WebRtcTransport has 0 channel listeners (1 before), dtlsState 'closed', events only observer:close; (B) control: a DTLS 'closed' delivered to the current transport reaches the handler (whipReconnecting true, grace timer set, 1 host-metrics call, session closed after the 150 ms grace), so the probe sees the branch when it runs; (C) after a replacing POST, 'closed' and 'failed' delivered to the replaced transport reach nothing: no events, no grace timer, whipReconnecting false, 0 host-metrics calls, and the new session and its open transport are still current after the grace period; (D) the same after DELETE (session stays closed, not revived into reconnecting); (E) a 'closed' notification already queued when closeWhipSession runs reaches nothing; (F) a client abort while transport.connect() is pending, with the listener already attached, leaves no grace timer or reconnecting state. (G) only under the claim's premise, with close() patched to emit dtlsstatechange 'closed' first, does the replacement session get a grace timer and get closed at expiry; mediasoup does not do that. No code changed. Checks on the unchanged lane: node --test tests/whipRoutes.test.js 7/7; npm run lint and npm run typecheck pass; npm test 1080/1080.
